compute_clip_loss: compute the average contrastive loss between captions and images using a similarity tensor
compute_negatives_loss: compute the pairwise BCE loss for positive and negative labeled image scores
pool_similarity_groups: pool an (B, N*B) similarity matrix into (B, B) using avg, max, or min pooling
extract_grouped_diagonal: extract the grouped diagonal from a (B, N*B) logits matrix into a (B, N) tensor
compute_contrastive_loss: compute cross-entropy contrastive loss from a logits tensor with auto-generated class indices
